scope: CPU-only replay of the frozen pi0.5-to-Panda inputs through the optimized atomic assurance runtime
research_question: Can persistent OSQP, conservative broad-phase pruning, safe-only configuration caching, and reusable braking workspaces make any complete frozen Panda action chunk executable without weakening the registered constraints or exposing a partial prefix?

input_contract.source_rows: the 90 direct-dispatch rows: 30 frozen official pi0.5 responses crossed with three registered Panda scenes
input_contract.action_identity: candidate Hx8 arrays, start states, source row indices, and response SHA-256 values are read from the manifest-bound v1 artifact

profiles.role: diagnostic separation of method infeasibility from CPU budget infeasibility

fixed_runtime_contract.case_reset: Each profile, source response, and scene starts at the registered scene state with zero joint velocity.
fixed_runtime_contract.cache_reset: The safe-configuration cache is empty at the start of every scored case; only reuse within one complete action assurance request is allowed.
fixed_runtime_contract.worker_lifecycle: One assurance worker remains alive per scene and profile. One-time worker startup and shutdown are measured separately and excluded from per-request supervision latency.
fixed_runtime_contract.publication: The atomic gate publishes either all Hx8 actions or no policy action.
fixed_runtime_contract.collision: World-space bounding-sphere lower bounds prune exact MuJoCo geometry distances only when the complete interval is certified above clearance.
fixed_runtime_contract.braking: Every action boundary retains sampled inverse-dynamics effort checks and one continuous certificate for its synchronized joint-linear stopping segment.

primary_outcomes: QP, continuous-collision, braking, and fallback stage latency
exact geometry evaluations, broad-phase prune rate, and safe-cache hits

go_no_go_rule.go: The operational_20ms profile executes at least one complete plan, publishes zero plans that fail the independent registered-constraint audit, exposes zero partial prefixes, and the artifact validates.
go_no_go_rule.no_go: No operational_20ms plan executes, any operational plan fails the independent audit, any partial prefix is exposed, or the artifact cannot be validated.
go_no_go_rule.diagnostic_profile: The diagnostic_100ms profile cannot change the operational decision; it only identifies candidates that are method-feasible under a relaxed CPU budget.

claim_boundaries: This protocol was fixed after implementation profiling and is an engineering audit, not a preregistered inferential study.
Frozen official responses are replayed; the pi0.5 checkpoint is not executed in this run.
LIBERO actions remain cross-controller inputs to Panda, not native Panda policy outputs.
Cases reset independently and do not feed Panda observations back to the policy.
Python CPU timing is best effort and is not a hard-real-time guarantee.
MuJoCo geometry and inverse dynamics are not physical-robot safety certification.
